text:
maria: Quick sync — PR #4723 adds the migration guide for the new routing flags + an SDK snippet. Target merge before v1.4.2 cutoff (2026-03-22 16:00 PT). This is gated on the 'new-routing' feature flag being enabled in canary. Need 2 reviewers + CI/docs preview green. @kevin @jamie can you take a look? Preview: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/4723 :eyes:

docs-ci-bot: Preview build started for PR #4723 — running lint/linkcheck/build (will post preview link when done).

kevin: I can review later today. Quick heads-up: the SDK snippet uses the old `Client` constructor — please switch to `ClientV2` and show how to pass the routing flag header. Also add a short note about pinning model versions for Private deployments.

jamie: will take a pass too, can we add an example for the batch endpoint? a one-liner is enough. tiny language nit in the intro.

maria: thanks — pushed fixups: switched to `ClientV2`, added batch endpoint example, and clarified the pinning note. Also added a versioned docs path: `/docs/v1.4.2/migration`. PTAL.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/4723 — checks: lint ✅, linkcheck ✅, build ✅, snapshot diff: small.

ben: Release team check — confirm: v1.4.2 cut is 2026-03-22 16:00 PT. If this merges, we need the feature flag enabled in canary by 10:00 PT so canary smoke tests exercise the change. Otherwise we risk docs mismatch with default behavior. Can we gate the merge on that?

maria: yes — plan: hold merge until (1) canary flag is ON and smoke tests green, and (2) two approvals are present. @kevin @jamie please approve when you see the live preview and the snippet change looks good.

kevin: approved — left one inline comment about renaming `routeHint` -> `routing_hint` for consistency, not blocking. :+1:

jamie: approved — fixed my language nit in a follow-up commit, looks good to me. :shipit:

release-bot: Feature flag update: `new-routing` toggled ON in us-west-2 canary at 2026-03-22T10:05Z by infra-ops.

maria: canary smoke tests passed at 10:15 PT (no regressions reported). I'll merge after the 10:20 PT quick sanity check and tag the PR with release-note: "docs: migration guide + SDK V2 snippet for new routing flags". If anything fails during the window we will revert and open a follow-up.

kevin: thanks — noted the variable rename offline.

jamie: leaving a reaction, everything else looks good.

maria: merged at 10:22 PT — marking done. Will follow up if QA finds anything.
